_doc: Bracket assemblies for MccFusionArchive. Each part STEP is exported in its own part frame (manifest print_pose as-modelled); these placements put it into the bracket's assembly frame exactly as the OpenSCAD 'assembly' preview does. x/y/z in mm, rz in degrees about +Z. Sources: arch-tv-bracket.scad _mcc_arch_tv_place() (translate [side*HALF_PITCH, 0, 0], rotate 0 left / 180 right; HALF_PITCH = 200) and the centre at [0, 0, ARCH_PLATE_T = 11]; vertical-tv-bracket.scad _mcc_vert_tv_place_assembly() (translate [0, side*HALF_PITCH_V, 0], rotate +alpha left / -alpha right) and the centre at [reach, 0, VTV_PLATE_T], with reach = 136.75, alpha = 36.5146, HALF_PITCH_V = 150, VTV_PLATE_T = 11 echoed by OpenSCAD from main abc10de. Spacers have no assembly position in the model (they fill the bracket's own unused VESA row); they are laid beside the bracket, marked loose. Re-echo these values whenever a bracket's geometry changes.
